correctness.rationale: The gnomonic face map and area are exact. By signed-reflection symmetry the five pure quadrupolar basis functions are pairwise orthogonal both globally and locally. Three integration-by-parts identities plus the area identity solve all required fourth moments exactly; resulting five Rayleigh quotients and their ordering prove the whole complex Hermitian spectrum. Symbolic checker verifies the exact moment system and independent quadrature checks 25 matrix entries to below 3e-15. The computation cannot substitute for the analytic proof and is used only for error detection.

value.rationale: A six-face cubed-sphere grid is a canonical regional domain for spherical harmonic analysis. Exact eigenvalues and equality functions give both optimal local energy observability and worst-case leakage for all complex pure quadratic modes, plus a sharp intrinsic condition number. This natural complete low-degree classification is useful for assessing regional transforms and cannot be inferred numerically or from a general existence theorem without evaluating the local moments.
